navigation.index_behavior: Root chapterItems excludes index.md unconditionally. nav_exclude keeps the index out of the list; the resulting sidebar has 38 reader links under four groups for 39 published pages. The index remains reachable at /tec-os/ and /tec-os/index.html. sidebar_link is only honored by sectionFor on subdirectory indexes, so adding it to the root index would not add an entry. No new sidebar index entry is assumed or required by this plan.
navigation.draft_exclusion: srcExclude prevents tec-os/editorial/** from publishing. The generator itself does not read srcExclude: rootItems is nonrecursive and splitSections needs an immediate subdirectory index. tec-os/editorial/index.md does not exist, so the nested draft index does not become a generated section. Keep this boundary intact.

generator_only_command.behavior: Reads frontmatter across all configured book directories and writes the one generated sidebar module. It has no build, child-process, browser, network, native assembler or deployment action. It accepts no TEC-OS-only scope flag.

navigation.config_boundary: cleanUrls false preserves .html route syntax, not deleted filenames. No base or rewrite option is configured. No TEC-OS entry currently exists in themeConfig.nav, so sidebar regeneration does not add a new top-nav shelf entry.
